summary: Iter 37 — Safety Forms feature: Backend 19/19 PASS (login wrong/right pw, /check token, issuance create + total $250 server-side, GET, PDF bytes start with %PDF, validation rules ack/sigs/Damaged-no-note, list admin-only enforcement, training create + PDF + admin-list filter). Frontend 10/10 PASS — /safety hub renders new 'Safety Forms' tile, click bounces to /safety/forms/login, wrong pw '0000' blocked (no nav), correct pw '1982' lands on /safety/forms hub with two tiles (issuance + training), no horizontal overflow at 390px on hub or either form, ES toggle changes content on hub, Sign Out clears localStorage token + bounces to /safety. Admin panel verified end-to-end: Safety Forms panel renders, TEST_Employee row shows $250.00 total under Issuance tab, employee filter narrows to '1 record', Training tab shows TEST_Trainee, Open + Download icons render per row. AUTO_EMAIL_REPORTS=false in preview so Resend correctly skipped (logged 'auto-email skipped'). PDF endpoint produces real %PDF bytes via WeasyPrint.
critical_code_review_comments: safety_forms.py — clean separation: HMAC-keyed safety token with admin override, list endpoints strip signatures/photos from response (good for payload size + privacy), _id excluded everywhere, condition='Damaged' validation enforced server-side. LGTM.
Issuance create endpoint correctly recomputes total_value server-side (1*150 + 2*50 = 250.00 returned), so frontend tampering can't fudge financial totals. LGTM.

Photo-required and 'Other' item-type-other validations are frontend-only (backend allows photos=[] / item_type_other=''). Acceptable since backend is the source of truth for ack + signatures + Damaged-note. If field crews ever bypass the SPA (e.g. direct POST), they could submit without a photo — flag for future hardening but NOT a blocker.
Auto-email skip path (AUTO_EMAIL_REPORTS=false) is logged at INFO and never throws — preview-safe. Production redeploy should flip env var per main agent's note.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Employee equipment-issuance ($250) and TEST_Trainee equipment-training via backend POST during test run. Visible in admin Safety Forms panel — main agent may want to clean up via mongo or expose a delete endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Safety Forms feature fully validated — backend + frontend + admin panel all green. Test data (TEST_Employee, TEST_Trainee) remains in safety_equipment_issuances / safety_equipment_trainings collections; if cleanup is desired, drop those docs by employee_name regex. Photo-required + Other-text validations enforced only client-side (NewSafetyEquipmentIssuance.jsx) — verified via UI but not directly via Playwright signature-draw flow due to canvas-drawing complexity (validation rules confirmed by code inspection). PDF generation via WeasyPrint works end-to-end. AUTO_EMAIL_REPORTS will need to flip to true on prod redeploy for Resend to fire to safety@mascigc.com + jaymn.judd@mascigc.com.
